lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with slightly increased width between the 4th and 5th segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line (shoulder) and the last two posterior lines (rump) are abbreviated, terminating before crossing the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the lateral aspect of the upper hind limb/haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align spatially to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the cheek; white patch on the lower throat; white markings on the upper forelimbs and lower hindlimbs.
